name: real1-textured-anisotropy
description: REAL-1: applies a synthetic high-frequency photo-textured (kind:'textured', the DLC/uploaded material path via userMaterials) finish to the living/dining floor, tilts to a close grazing angle toward the horizon, and screenshots it alongside a procedural wood floor at the SAME angle (no-regression control). Run once with cache.ts's textured-branch `applyAnisotropy` call removed (BEFORE — expect blurry/aliased at the horizon) and once with it present (AFTER — expect sharp to the horizon, procedural shot unchanged either way).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setItems?.([])

steps.name: build-synthetic-texture
steps.eval: (() => { const N = 512; const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = N; c.height = N; const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); ctx.fillStyle = '#b08968'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, N, N); const cell = 32; for (let y = 0; y < N; y += cell) { for (let x = 0; x < N; x += cell) { const shade = ((x / cell + y / cell) % 2 === 0) ? '#8a6647' : '#c9a27c'; ctx.fillStyle = shade; ctx.fillRect(x, y, cell, cell); } } ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,25,10,0.9)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (let x = 0; x <= N; x += cell) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, N); ctx.stroke(); } for (let y = 0; y <= N; y += cell) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(N, y); ctx.stroke(); } window.__syntheticAlbedo = c.toDataURL('image/png'); })()

steps.name: add-user-material
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); st.addUserMaterial({ id: 'user-real1-plank', name: 'REAL-1 test plank', category: 'floor', kind: 'textured', source: 'user', swatch: '#a9835c', textures: { albedo: window.__syntheticAlbedo }, runtimeUrls: { albedo: window.__syntheticAlbedo }, uvScale: [1, 1] }); return st.userMaterials.length; })()

steps.name: camera-grazing
steps.eval: (() => { const cam = window.__three.camera; const controls = window.__three.controls; cam.position.set(10.55, 0.3, 2.0); controls.target.set(10.55, 0.15, 6.4); controls.update(); })()
